//: Plan budgets for the AI usage meter. The collector upserts these into mission.ai_plans for MC_USER_ID on every run. Edit here, not in the DB. Claude plans are split by ACCOUNT (the Claude config dir a log sits in; see scripts/usage/collect-logs.mjs and docs/ai-usage.md): claude-max = main (ejaffejax@gmail.com, ~/.claude), claude-4lot = ejaffe@4lot.org (~/.claude-4lot and ~/.claude-reserve). Anthropic publishes no token cap, so limit_value is null ('no cap known', shown neutral grey with burn in tokens); a manual percent reading from Claude's usage page (CoS, manual.jsonl) drives its % and forecast when present. Set limit_value (tokens/week, estimate) only if Eric picks a budget.
